name: orin-dx-agent-plugins
description: Nine cooperating plugins covering the full development lifecycle — from requirement capture through spec, plan, implementation, verification, and shipping.

plugins.name: basis
plugins.description: Meta-plugin for scaffolding and auditing plugins, skills, and agents. Generates plugin directory structure and validates conformance to ecosystem schemas.

plugins.name: proof
plugins.description: Cross-language bug hunting. Finds real bugs in live code through recon, hazard scanning, adversarial verification, and exit-gate verdict. Supersedes bug-hunter-rust and bug-hunter-ts.

plugins.name: axiom
plugins.description: Cross-cutting verification gate. Confirms that any stage artifact meets its criteria before the next stage begins. Skills: verify-requirement, verify-spec, verify-plan, verify-implementation, verify-pr, exit-gate.

plugins.name: graph
plugins.description: Need definition plugin. Captures and structures requirements before implementation begins. Integrates with GitHub Issues by default; extensible to Linear, Jira, or any issue tracker.

plugins.name: trace
plugins.description: Research plugin. Investigates questions and requirements to build a documented evidence base before committing to a solution direction. Produces research-report@1.

plugins.name: canon
plugins.description: Specification plugin. Turns requirements and research reports into unambiguous, testable specs. Detects spec drift against actual code.

plugins.name: vector
plugins.description: Planning plugin. Decomposes specs into sequenced, bite-sized implementation plans with TDD steps, exact code, and commit messages. No TBDs.

plugins.name: lambda
plugins.description: Implementation plugin. Executes plans via TDD cycle. Produces committed, tested code verified by the axiom exit gate.

plugins.name: delta
plugins.description: Shipping plugin. Shepherds completed code through commit, PR creation, review response, and changeset documentation.
